# 0070: Pricing updates start with a manual Makefile check

Status: accepted, 2026-10-13.
Supersedes [0067](0067-a-priced-release-is-catalogued-or-excluded-before-it-is-curated.md) only on the weekly workflow and issue automation.
Its catalogue decision gate remains in force.

## Context

The maintainer wants pricing discovery on demand, run directly or delegated to an agent.
A weekly GitHub Action that publishes issues and PRs is outside that intended workflow.
The existing curator already knows which rates changed and which releases need a catalogue decision.

## Decision

**Remove the pricing GitHub Action.** Neither a schedule nor a manually dispatched pricing workflow remains.
The existing build, test and release workflows keep their purposes.

**`make prices-check` runs the curator with `--check`.** It fetches the feed, applies the catalogue gate and compares its rows with the open record.
It reports `pricing PR needed: yes` or `no`, with the changes, and exits successfully for either completed comparison.
It stages and writes no price records, and creates no issues or PRs.
Detection works on the open record's day because it does not create a dated interval.

**An undecided release still stops before writes.** The error reports `pricing PR needed: catalogue decision required`, with the model ids and source links.
Other feed failures remain errors rather than being labelled as successful comparisons.

**Publication is a separate step.** Decide the catalogue entries, run `make prices` and `make test`, then raise a PR for review.
The existing offline `prices-sync` test prerequisite remains unchanged.

## Consequences

A person or agent can ask whether a pricing PR is needed without changing bundled records.
Pricing checks run when requested, and do not publish repository content on a timer.
Successful comparisons use their explicit output to distinguish changes from no changes.
Unknown releases continue to require an adoption decision before curation can write them.

## Lens

Detect a review need without publishing anything.
Let a person or their agent choose when to check and when to raise the resulting PR.
